items.question: What kind of seat should be placed there for worship?
premises: A seat is placed there.
It is fixed and śakti-made.
items.inference: The rite requires a fixed śakti-made seat placed there.
items.plain_english: Place there a fixed seat made by śakti.

items.question: What kinds of seats are suitable for the rite?
premises: The seat may be auspicious.
It may be red, variegated, or charming.
items.inference: Suitable seats include auspicious, red, variegated, or charming ones.
items.plain_english: On an auspicious, red, variegated, or charming seat.

items.question: What seat should be made for the satisfaction of deities?
premises: Vīrāsana is made.
It is for deity satisfaction.
items.inference: Vīrāsana should be made for the satisfaction of deities.
items.plain_english: For the satisfaction of deities, make vīrāsana, O Śiva.

items.question: What seat is declared for the divine ones of the left siddhānta?
premises: Their seat is own-wish seat.
It is declared.
items.inference: The own-wish seat is declared for them.
items.plain_english: For the divine ones of the left siddhānta, the own-wish seat is declared.

items.question: Is a fixed rule prescribed for the divine ones of the left siddhānta?
premises: No fixed rule is prescribed.
It concerns those divine ones.
items.inference: No fixed rule is prescribed for them.
items.plain_english: No fixed rule is prescribed for the divine ones of the left siddhānta.

items.question: Where should the rite be performed?
premises: It should be in seclusion.
The place should be solitary, pleasant, or free from obstacle.
items.inference: The rite belongs in a secluded, solitary, pleasant, obstacle-free place.
items.plain_english: In seclusion, in a solitary, pleasant place free from obstacles.

items.question: What should be drawn on the seat with blood?
premises: A triangle is drawn.
It is drawn with blood on the seat.
items.inference: A triangle should be drawn on the seat with blood.
items.plain_english: With blood, O excellent one, draw a triangle on the seat.

items.question: What seat is to be known and with what is it worshipped?
premises: The earth-cakra seat is to be known.
It is worshipped with sandal, flowers, rice, etc.
items.inference: The earth-cakra seat is to be known and worshipped with those offerings.
items.plain_english: The earth-cakra seat is to be known, worshipped with sandal, flowers, rice, and so on.

items.question: How should ādhāra-śakti be worshipped?
premises: Ādhāra-śakti is worshipped.
It is worshipped up to the lotus, threefold.
items.inference: Ādhāra-śakti should be worshipped up to the lotus in three ways.
items.plain_english: Worship ādhāra-śakti up to the lotus, threefold, O Śiva.

items.question: Can that mantra be made known for crores of births?
premises: That mantra cannot be made known.
This holds for crores of births.
items.inference: That mantra cannot be made known even across crores of births.
items.plain_english: That mantra cannot be made known for crores of births.

items.question: What height should the seat have in the śrīcakra?
premises: The seat should not be too low.
It should not be too high.
items.inference: The seat in the śrīcakra should be neither too low nor too high.
items.plain_english: The seat in the śrīcakra should be neither too low nor too high, dear one.

items.question: Who may be śakti-endowed and accompanied by rites?
premises: The devotee of deity and guru may be so.
He is śakti-endowed and with rites.
items.inference: The deity-guru devotee may be śakti-endowed and accompanied by rites.
items.plain_english: The devotee of deity and guru also may be śakti-endowed and accompanied by rites.

items.question: How should the guru be adorned?
premises: The guru is adorned.

items.inference: The guru should be adorned with red unguents, sandal, and fine dress.
items.plain_english: The guru, adorned with red unguents, sandal, and fine dress.

items.question: With what should the guru be anointed and adorned?
premises: He is joined with red sandal.
He is adorned with red flowers.
items.inference: The guru should be joined with red sandal and adorned with red flowers.
items.plain_english: Joined with red sandal and adorned with red flowers.

items.question: Who may act in its absence and who may not?
premises: A vaiśya may act in its absence.
A śūdra may never act.
items.inference: In its absence a vaiśya may act, but a śūdra never.
items.plain_english: In its absence a vaiśya may act, but never a śūdra.

items.question: What becomes abhiṣeka by their hand?
premises: Drinking by their hand becomes abhiṣeka.
This is addressed to the dear one.
items.inference: Drinking performed by their hand becomes abhiṣeka.
items.plain_english: Drinking by their hand becomes abhiṣeka, dear one.

items.question: What should be done with the wine vessel?
premises: The wine vessel is placed in hand.
One should seat it on the seat.
items.inference: The wine vessel should be held in hand and seated on the seat.
items.plain_english: Having placed the wine vessel in hand, seat it on the seat.

items.question: What disposition is required for the practitioner?
premises: He is devoted to deity meditation.
items.inference: The practitioner must be devoted to deity meditation.
items.plain_english: Devoted to meditation on the deity.

items.question: What enters the śrīcakras through the śakti hand?
premises: The self-vessel enters.
It enters through the śakti hand into śrīcakras.
items.inference: The self-vessel enters the śrīcakras through the śakti hand.
items.plain_english: The self-vessel enters the śrīcakras through the śakti hand.

items.question: What is held in the śakti hand?
premises: The drinking vessel is in the śakti hand.

items.inference: The drinking vessel is held in the śakti hand, with śakti holding on the own left.
items.plain_english: The drinking vessel is in the śakti hand; śakti holding is on the own left.

items.question: What is that cakra without doubt?
premises: That cakra is divine cakra.
There is no doubt.
items.inference: That cakra is the divine cakra, without doubt.
items.plain_english: That cakra, O Paramēśāna, is the divine cakra, no doubt.

items.question: Who becomes free from fear and shame after entering the śrīcakras?
premises: She enters the śrīcakras.
She becomes free from fear and shame.
items.inference: She becomes free from fear and shame after entering the śrīcakras.
items.plain_english: Having entered the śrīcakras, she becomes free from fear and shame.

items.question: When does purity of substances occur?
premises: Purity of substances occurs.
It occurs at that moment.
items.inference: Purity of substances occurs at that moment.
items.plain_english: Purity of substances occurs at that moment.

items.question: What should be cast into the yoni-maṇḍala?
premises: A drop is taken from the vessel.
